market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by broad consolidation across all assets following earlier directional declines. XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD all trade below their session VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows (VAL). However, downward momentum has decelerated into horizontal ranges above session lows. Muted RVOL (under 1.0) across most pairs and climactic absorption volume on GBPUSD signal exhaustion of the intraday trend rather than clean continuation breakouts, warranting a 100% HOLD stance across the board.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluence factors: 1) Volume Profile: price_vs_value_area is below_val (VAL 3884.90) and close_vs_poc is below (POC 3978.13), keeping structural bias defensive. 2) CVD: BEARISH at -6.16, though cvd_slope is slightly positive at +1.66 indicating fading selling momentum. 3) Session: NEW_YORK_SESSION late afternoon chop. 4) Trend: price is positioned well below downward-sloping VWAP (3930.36) and EMA50 (3909.64). 5) ATR bands: price is consolidating mid-channel between the EMA20 baseline (3884.22) and lower ATR band (3865.74). 6) Volume: RVOL is 0.85 with no yellow RVOL spikes, indicating lack of breakout commitment. 7) S/R and GEX: price holds above Session Low (3852.35); GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (3866.64) with Call Wall #2 directly overhead at 3886.84 capping upside, while Put Wall #1 sits at 3821.33. With price compressed below VAL and Call Wall #2 in dampening mode, setup lacks directional edge. Defaulting to HOLD.
